first_signal_definition: first consecutive red-qualified raw candidate before POC/slots/cash/execution; not first POC true
execution_price_formula: L + q * (H - L); registered midpoint q=.5/.5, conservative buy=.7 sell=.3
signal_timing: T close -> T+1 buy; first episode miss is not chased
